active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; no strong rolling mean subtraction in first implementation
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: 675a confirms 674a is a real IV-only improvement at higher sample count. Remaining stable failures are strict per-cell coverage, one persistent conditional-width outlier, regime layer-2 per-cell coverage, and median-bias distributional fidelity.
last_result_summary: 675a reevaluated the 674a best checkpoint with samples=96 and reached 7/11. Mean reversion passed, coverage90 improved to 0.845, calibration error to 0.041, level KS stayed 15/25 passed, pathwise KS was 0.432 passed, and median-bias stayed 16/25 failed. Failed suites were coverage, conditionality, regime coverage, and distributional fidelity.
next_step_recommendation: Do not add another IV-only mechanism immediately. Test whether the 674a recipe transfers to joint38, because the project objective is a general IV plus anchor-factor generator rather than an IV-only model.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. Within the clean general IV/anchor/joint state-aware normalized-innovation family, 666a remains the best joint-audited checkpoint, while 674a/675a is the strongest recent IV-only candidate at 7/11 with high-sample evaluation: coverage90 0.845, level KS passed, mean reversion passed, and pathwise realism passed. A joint38 audit is required before promoting the 674a-style training recipe as the general baseline.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
